daily.career: Sun square Mars has tension written all over it, but honestly? That friction can push you to propose something you've been sitting on. Your communication skills are sharp today—use them to advocate for what you actually want instead of going with the flow.
daily.health: Saturn retrograde in Aries is asking you to revisit boundaries you've let slip. With all this Mars-Jupiter fire, you've got energy—just make sure you're not burning out. Move your body, drink water, actually rest when you need it.
